segments.name: Sale of wireless access products
segments.evidence: We have one reportable segment, consisting of the sale of wireless access products.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by selling wireless access products directly to wireless operators and indirectly through strategic partners and distributors, primarily in North America and Asia.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are generally marketed and sold directly to wireless operators and indirectly through strategic partners and distributors.

changes.text: In 2024, the company formed the Sigbeat joint venture to handle worldwide sales, marketing, customer support and operations for telecommunications modules.
changes.evidence: On May 14, 2024, we entered into an Agreement for Formation of a Joint Venture Corporation (the "Agreement").

changes.text: In 2026, the company began a strategic shift away from mobile hotspot products toward fixed wireless routers and telecommunications modules.
changes.evidence: During the six months ended June 30, 2026, we began implementing a strategic shift to reduce our reliance on mobile hotspot products and increase our focus on fixed wireless routers and telecommunications modules.
